Messages.Author: Max
Messages.Body:
Immortal Grapple card text says: "... A *vampire* may play only one
Immortal Grapple each round."

Does this mean that an ally like Ghouled Street Thug may play more
than one in a round ?

Thank you.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Hmm. Overhastiness on my part.
The cited ruling is for cards in play.
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3CD12D43.F05AB684%40white-wolf.com

For restrictions on "play", however, which is done "as a vampire", then
the restriction would still hold.

So the Ghouled Street Thug could only play one IG each round.

My apologies for the slip.
